title: config/generated.json
description: The generated-file rule of AGENTS.md, read by the pre-commit hook (generated-files.mts): a staged path with a generated segment is refused, and so is a staged path that a glob of paths matches; an exception glob accepts it again.

paths.description: Globs of repository paths that are generated on top of the segments kit refuses (node_modules, vendor, .venv, venv, __pycache__, target, dist, *.egg-info), such as a build output folder of the repository. Read by picomatch with dot: true.

tracked.description: Generated sources that a consumer installs as the tagged tree itself, such as a Go module or a Rust crate: each glob of repository paths is tracked in Git, and its reason says why; the directory of each glob must hold a go.mod or a Cargo.toml (P34). Read by picomatch with dot: true.

exceptions.description: Generated segments that the repository keeps, each glob of repository paths with its reason, such as test fixtures: read by picomatch with dot: true. A glob names one deliberate file set, never a whole generated folder; an exception exempts the path from the generated-file and duplication checks (K958).
